Here is the record trail for WO-26-04201 (Bldg 412 Rm 214, Emergency):

Clock

- Respond due 2026-08-25 22:40. Resolve due 2026-08-26 21:40.

Work
- HT-0001 diagnose (D. Reyes): failed run capacitor read 1.8 uF vs 5 uF rating; drain pan float switch tripped; pan cleared, water extracted.
- HT-0002 inspection (T. Hale): room recorded NOT HABITABLE (85F, wet carpet); occupant moved by CQ.
- ORD-0001 (V1, Q-00001, $15.84): capacitor AC-RC5-440R, delivered Bldg 412 (SC26799008).

- HT-0007 mitigation (D. Reyes): re-dry.
- HT-0009 verification (T. Hale): PASSED. 72F, RH 52%, carpet dry by moisture meter. Room returned to service. WO closed.

Issues the record also shows: the first verification failed (HT-0004), and there was back office lag: repair cued 2.5 h after carrier delivery, and verification cued 2.5 h after repair. The 24 h clock was still met.
How do I know that record isn't something your agent made up?

cases.draft:
Fair question. I can't prove it from inside this chat; I'm the agent reading the record, so my word isn't independent evidence. What I can do is point to the parts that come from outside BRP's agents so you can check them yourself:

- The verification was done by a person: HT-0009 is a barracks manager task completed by T. Hale (sample). You can ask T. Hale directly.
- The diagnosis and repair are technician tasks completed by D. Reyes (sample): HT-0001, HT-0003, HT-0007.
- The part was bought from an outside vendor: ORD-0001, V1 Southside HVAC Supply (sample), quote Q-00001, PO-26-00001, carrier SAMPLE-COURIER tracking SC26799008, delivered to Bldg 412.
- The intake has a photo attached (wet carpet at the AC closet door) and room sensor readings (IN-0001).

Agents are not allowed to complete a human task, mark work verified, or change a record. Agents also can't close a work order without a passed barracks manager verification.

For a formal check, I can ask the program manager to arrange access to the underlying records for you. Do you want me to send that?
